generation.prompt: Repaint reference1 into an opaque clean hand-painted HD RPG tile atlas. EXACT1024x1536 pixels,8 columns12 rows of128px squares. This is a source atlas; keep EVERY source shape at the EXACT same coordinates, size, colors and orientation, preserving cutoffs at cell boundaries. No gutters, gridlines, cell borders, reordering or recentering. Paint the complete cells, including original green regions and ALL visible objects; do not erase an object merely because it is green. Preserve flat olive/dark green ground with broad soft painterly strokes; restrained texture, no new grass blades, flowers, bushes or scenery. Smooth source pixel stair steps while keeping source contour positions and topology. No new symbols, labels, people, writing or inferred details. Black source openings remain black; flat blue regions remain flat blue. Reference2/3 ONLY provide brush style, never add their objects or colors. Preserve the gray straight trim and dark tiny hatch pattern snippets, dark irregular cobbles and tan gaps, small dome shapes including the actual green one, tan round vertical form on green, brown cliff boundaries, olive/dark green and tan flat areas, thin blue edge snippets, and the original large gray rectangle shape.
